# Multimodal models

[简体中文](../../../../learning/paths/multimodal-models/index.md) · English

Study three questions: how to align modalities, how to budget visual evidence, and how to predict states and the consequences of actions.

Choose a subtopic and start with its paper questions.

<article class="ar-learning-topic-tile">
<h2><a href="alignment-interfaces/">Cross-modal alignment: representations, connectors, and supervision</a></h2>
<p>How do images, speech, and text connect to the same task? Does the model learn similarity or learn to generate answers?</p>
<p class="ar-learning-topic-meta">85 questions · 21 papers</p>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-topic-tile">
<h2><a href="visual-evidence-budget/">Visual evidence budgets: tokens, frames, and on-demand revisiting</a></h2>

<p class="ar-learning-topic-meta">72 questions · 18 papers</p>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-topic-tile">

<p class="ar-learning-topic-meta">108 questions · 27 papers</p>
